correctness.rationale: For L²=16 and the sixteen mutually disjoint (-2)-curves, direct independent rational Gram-matrix calculation verifies F=(L−A1−A2−A3−A4)/2, F²=2, F·Ai=F·Bi=1 for i≤4, F·Aj=0 for j≥5, Bi=F−Ai, Bi²=−2 and Bi·Bj=0 (i≠j). For any other irreducible root Γ=aL−ΣbiAi, nonnegativity bi≥0 and Σbi²=8a²+1 give S²≤32a²+4 with S=Σi≤4 bi. F·Γ<0 would imply a²<1/8, impossible for positive half-integral a. Equality F·Γ=0 forces a=0; the source Lemma 8 coefficient constraint then leaves only Aj (j≥5) as effective orthogonal roots. Saint-Donat’s fixed-part alternative F=2E+R would force R=Aj and L-coefficient 1/4 in E, forbidden by Lemma 8; hence |F| is free. Primitive nef square-two linear system is a double-plane model. The pullback of each splitting line is Ai+Bi; the deck involution exchanges those two distinct degree-one components and permutes the twelve contracted Aj, sending the complete original Nikulin configuration to its replacement. This is an infinite lattice/linear-system argument, not established merely by the finite Gram check.
